info.title: API.SH: Trip.com
info.description: The Trip.com API from API.SH: public Trip.com data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A destination's top attractions as Trip.com ranks them: name (also English and local), type tags, score, review counts, popularity score, ticket price and bookings, opening status and today's hours, typical visit length, address, area, coordinates, ranking, introduction, a review snippet, image and link. Also returns the total number of attractions and the attraction types.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tripcom-attractions

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Trip.com destination id (e.g. 191 for Bangkok), or pass url.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A trip.com travel-guide destination or attraction link, instead of id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The lowest one-way fare Trip.com shows for each departure day over about the next year between two airports or cities, with the overall lowest price. Days without a fare have a null price.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tripcom-flight-calendar

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Departure airport or city code (IATA).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Arrival airport or city code (IATA).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: A departure date the calendar is centred on, YYYY-MM-DD (default: a month from today).

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description: Adult passengers, 1 to 9 (default 1).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency code (default USD).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One-way flights between two airports or cities on a date, as Trip.com lists them: total price, price per adult, taxes, seats left, stops, duration, departure and arrival, airlines, cabin and fare class, baggage included, fare name and every segment (flight number, airline, operator, airports and terminals, times, duration, aircraft). Also returns the number of results and the lowest price.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tripcom-flights

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Departure airport or city code (IATA), e.g. NYC or JFK.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Arrival airport or city code (IATA).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description: Adult passengers, 1 to 9 (default 1).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency code (default USD).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: recommended (default), cheapest or fastest.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Flights to return (default 50, up to 200).

get.description:
The first page of Trip.com hotels for a city and stay (about 12): name, stars, review score, count and subscores, neighborhood, coordinates, nightly price and total with taxes, cheapest room, tags and photos, plus `total_results` for the city. Trip.com city ids: the number in a Trip.com list URL (e.g. /hotels/paris-hotels-list-192/ is 192; Shanghai 2, Tokyo 228, New York 633). Filter by star rating, nightly price range, guest rating, property amenities, breakfast included and free cancellation; sort by price, reviews, stars or distance; price for children and in another currency. Applied filters come back in `applied_filters`. `next_page` is always null (one page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tripcom-hotels

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Trip.com city id.

parameters.name: check_in
parameters.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD (default: 30 days from today).

parameters.name: check_out
parameters.description: Check-out date YYYY-MM-DD (default: 2 nights after check_in).

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description: Adults (default 2).

parameters.name: rooms
parameters.description: Rooms (default 1).

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: Children (0-8); give their ages in child_ages.

parameters.name: child_ages
parameters.description: Ages of the children (0-17), comma-separated, one per child (e.g. 5,8).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Price currency, 3-letter code (default USD; e.g. EUR, GBP, JPY).

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language of names, review labels, locations and tags (default en-US); hotel links point to that language's site.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: recommended (default), price_asc, price_desc, top_reviewed, stars_desc, distance.

parameters.name: star
parameters.description: Star ratings, comma-separated (e.g. 4,5; 1 or 2 means 2 stars or fewer).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum nightly price in the chosen currency.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum nightly price in the chosen currency.

parameters.name: rating_min
parameters.description: Minimum guest rating out of 10: 6, 7, 8 or 9.

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: Property amenity ids, comma-separated (e.g. 42 gym, 65 spa, 656 parking, 362 laundry room, 110 elevator).

parameters.name: breakfast
parameters.description: true: rooms with breakfast included.

parameters.name: free_cancellation
parameters.description: true: rooms with free cancellation.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Review summary of a Trip.com hotel (score, subscores, review count, review tags, traveler types, languages) and the reviews shown on its page (about 10): rating, subscores, text, date, stay date, traveler type, room, reviewer, photos and the hotel response. `next_page` is always null (one page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tripcom-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Trip.com hotel id. Either id or url is required.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Trip.com hotel page URL (used when id is absent).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
